items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It was Dean Corson. His son is still teaching at the – when he met me, he started telling me, “Boy, you sure raised some – my father was always talking about you at home.”

ctx.x: This is Darrell Bodley. Dean Bodley?

No, thank God. It was Dean Corson. His son is still teaching at the – when he met me, he started telling me, “Boy, you sure raised some – my father was always talking about you at home.” The punishment was we had to live a mile off campus. We moved to Tuxedo Circle.
